points.title: 童年与少年时期
points.description: 吴承恩出生于江苏淮安的一个书香门第，从小聪颖好学。他的父亲吴锐是个小商人，但重视教育。吴承恩自幼博览群书，尤其喜爱神话传说和民间故事。这一时期，他接受了传统的儒家教育，同时也受到民间文化的熏陶，为他后来的文学创作奠定了基础。淮安的运河文化和民间传说成为他日后创作《西游记》的重要素材来源。
points.descriptionEn: Wu Cheng'en was born into a scholarly family in Huai'an, Jiangsu Province. His father Wu Rui was a small businessman but valued education. From a young age, Wu was intelligent and studious, reading extensively and particularly enjoying myths, legends, and folk tales. During this period, he received traditional Confucian education while also being influenced by folk culture, laying the foundation for his later literary creations. The canal culture and folk legends of Huai'an became important sources for his later work 'Journey to the West'.

points.title: 科举之路
points.description: 青年时期的吴承恩前往南京参加科举考试，但多次落第。在南京期间，他广泛结交文人雅士，游历江南各地，积累了丰富的社会阅历和文学素材。这一时期，他开始尝试文学创作，写下了不少诗词和散文。虽然科举不顺，但这段经历使他深入了解了明代社会的各种面貌，尤其是官场的腐败和科举制度的弊端，这些经历都成为他后来创作的重要素材。南京的繁华与市井生活也丰富了他的文学视野。
points.descriptionEn: In his youth, Wu Cheng'en traveled to Nanjing to participate in the imperial examinations but failed multiple times. During his time in Nanjing, he extensively associated with scholars and literati, traveled throughout the Jiangnan region, and accumulated rich social experience and literary material. During this period, he began attempting literary creation, writing many poems and essays. Although unsuccessful in the examinations, this experience allowed him to deeply understand various aspects of Ming Dynasty society, especially the corruption in official circles and the drawbacks of the examination system, which became important material for his later works. The prosperity and urban life of Nanjing also enriched his literary perspective.

points.title: 游历江南
points.description: 吴承恩离开南京后，游历了江南各地，包括杭州、苏州等地。在杭州期间，他游览了西湖名胜，接触了丰富的民间传说和佛教文化。这一时期，他的文学创作更加成熟，开始构思《西游记》的雏形。杭州的佛教文化和西湖传说给了他极大启发，特别是关于玄奘西行取经的故事。同时，他也深入了解了明代中期的社会矛盾和民生疾苦，这些都在他的作品中有所体现。这段游历生活极大地丰富了他的创作素材和艺术想象力。
points.descriptionEn: After leaving Nanjing, Wu Cheng'en traveled throughout Jiangnan, including Hangzhou and Suzhou. During his time in Hangzhou, he visited West Lake scenic spots and was exposed to rich folk legends and Buddhist culture. During this period, his literary creation became more mature, and he began to conceive the prototype of 'Journey to the West'. Hangzhou's Buddhist culture and West Lake legends greatly inspired him, especially stories about Xuanzang's journey to the West for Buddhist scriptures. Meanwhile, he also deeply understood the social contradictions and people's livelihood issues of the mid-Ming Dynasty, which were reflected in his works. This period of traveling greatly enriched his creative material and artistic imagination.

points.title: 隐居创作
points.description: 回到家乡淮安后，吴承恩开始专心创作。这一时期，他生活相对清贫，但文学创作进入了高峰期。他完成了《西游记》的大部分创作，这部作品融合了佛教、道教和民间传说，以唐僧师徒西天取经为主线，塑造了孙悟空、猪八戒等经典形象。同时，他还创作了《禹鼎志》等志怪小说和大量诗词散文。淮安的民间文化和自然环境为他的创作提供了丰富的素材。这一时期的生活虽然清贫，但却是他文学成就最高的阶段，《西游记》的创作奠定了他在中国文学史上的重要地位。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to his hometown Huai'an, Wu Cheng'en began to focus on his writing. During this period, his life was relatively poor, but his literary creation entered a peak period. He completed most of 'Journey to the West', which integrated Buddhism, Taoism, and folk tales, with the main line being the journey of Tang Monk and his disciples to the West for Buddhist scriptures, creating classic characters like Sun Wukong and Zhu Bajie. At the same time, he also created supernatural novels like 'Yu Ding Zhi' and numerous poems and essays. The folk culture and natural environment of Huai'an provided rich material for his creation. Although this period of life was poor, it was the stage of his highest literary achievement, and the creation of 'Journey to the West' established his important position in Chinese literary history.

points.title: 晚年岁月
points.description: 晚年的吴承恩继续在淮安生活，完成了《西游记》的最后修订工作。这一时期，他的声望逐渐提高，但生活依然清贫。他时常与当地文人交流，继续创作诗词和散文。1579年，他完成了《西游记》的最终定稿，这部作品成为中国古代四大名著之一。吴承恩晚年还致力于整理和创作其他文学作品，包括《花草新编》等。1582年，吴承恩在淮安逝世，享年约82岁。他的作品在他生前并未引起广泛关注，但死后却流传千古，成为中国文学宝库中的瑰宝。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Wu Cheng'en continued to live in Huai'an, completing the final revisions of 'Journey to the West'. During this period, his reputation gradually increased, but his life remained poor. He often communicated with local literati and continued to create poems and essays. In 1579, he completed the final version of 'Journey to the West', which became one of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature. In his later years, Wu also devoted himself to organizing and creating other literary works, including 'Hua Cao Xin Bian'. In 1582, Wu Cheng'en passed away in Huai'an at the age of about 82. His works did not receive widespread attention during his lifetime, but have been passed down through generations, becoming treasures in the treasure trove of Chinese literature.

supporter.zh: 吴承恩被誉为中国古典文学的巨匠，《西游记》的创作展现了他非凡的想象力和深厚的文学功底。他通过神话故事的形式，巧妙地批判了明代社会的黑暗面，表达了对理想社会的向往。作品中的孙悟空形象更是成为中国文学中最具代表性的角色之一，体现了作者对自由精神的赞美。吴承恩的作品不仅丰富了中国的文学宝库，也为世界文学贡献了独特的东方智慧。
supporter.en: Wu Cheng'en is hailed as a master of classical Chinese literature. His creation of 'Journey to the West' demonstrates his extraordinary imagination and profound literary skill. Through the form of mythical stories, he skillfully criticized the dark aspects of Ming Dynasty society and expressed his yearning for an ideal society. The character of Sun Wukong has become one of the most representative figures in Chinese literature, reflecting the author's praise for the spirit of freedom. Wu's works not only enriched China's literary treasure but also contributed unique Eastern wisdom to world literature.

critic.zh: 批评者认为吴承恩的作品存在明显的时代局限性，尤其是对封建礼教的妥协和对佛教思想的过度推崇。《西游记》中的某些情节和人物塑造也显得过于简单化，缺乏深度。此外，吴承恩一生科举不顺，未能进入仕途，这使得他的作品缺乏对政治现实的深刻理解，更多停留在幻想层面。他的文学成就虽然高，但在思想深度和艺术创新方面仍有不足。
critic.en: Critics argue that Wu Cheng'en's works have clear limitations of his era, especially his compromise with feudal ethics and excessive promotion of Buddhist thought. Some plots and characterizations in 'Journey to the West' also appear overly simplistic and lacking depth. Furthermore, Wu's repeated failures in the imperial examinations and inability to enter officialdom meant his works lacked profound understanding of political reality, remaining more at the level of fantasy. While his literary achievements were high, there were still deficiencies in ideological depth and artistic innovation.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，吴承恩及其作品已成为中国文化的重要符号。《西游记》不仅是一部文学巨著，更是一种文化现象，影响了后世无数文学、艺术和影视作品。吴承恩通过神话故事的形式，巧妙地融合了儒、释、道三教思想，展现了中国传统文化的精髓。在当代，孙悟空形象已成为中国文化走向世界的代表符号之一，体现了吴承恩作品的跨时代价值和全球影响力。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Wu Cheng'en and his works have become important symbols of Chinese culture. 'Journey to the West' is not only a literary masterpiece but also a cultural phenomenon that has influenced countless literary, artistic, and film works throughout history. Through mythical stories, Wu skillfully integrated the thoughts of Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism, showcasing the essence of traditional Chinese culture. In contemporary times, the image of Sun Wukong has become one of the representative symbols of Chinese culture going global, reflecting the cross-era value and global influence of Wu's works.

self.zh: 心生，种种魔生；心灭，种种魔灭。
self.en: When the heart gives rise to thoughts, demons arise; when the heart is extinguished, demons perish.

others.zh: 《西游记》是中国小说中的一部杰作，它以神话的形式反映了明代社会的现实，同时又超越了时代，成为永恒的经典。
others.en: 'Journey to the West' is a masterpiece in Chinese novels, reflecting the reality of Ming Dynasty society in mythical form while transcending its time to become an eternal classic.
